source_claim: The official DRAGON BALL site identifies a sixteen-character roster for its Dragon Ball character tournament. The exact roster names match seven current residual catalog tags without alias or variant interpretation: Tenshinhan, Piccolo, Goten, Mr. Satan, Frieza, Majin Buu, and Yamcha. The official site context grounds each listed character in Dragon Ball and supports the stable Dragon Ball HOME root for these exact identities.
notes: One official roster source yielded all exact unambiguous current campaign matches. Other roster names were excluded where the exact catalog identity was absent, a distinct form/variant was present, or alias resolution would be required.
